# Learnings and mistakes

No structural facts are generated for this page; the store has no concept of a mistake, only of records, decisions and handovers. Everything here is written by hand.

## Notes (human, preserved verbatim on regeneration)

<!-- bm-human:begin -->
1. A gate must never run while the tree is being edited. This session
   broke that twice and both times the gate refused with a dirty-tree
   message that reads like a test failure and is not one.

2. A root cause is not proven until the fix works. The first diagnosis
   of the starving gate blamed a 678 MB directory copy; that fix landed
   and the suite starved again. Only an executed experiment found the
   real mechanism, and the experiment also disproved the obvious second
   guess. Both are recorded in queue item SBE2.

3. Long silence is not a stall. The founder thought the session had
   hung, and he was right to ask, because a 13 to 25 minute gate that
   prints nothing is indistinguishable from a hang. That is a product
   defect, not a communication one.

4. Eighteen real problems survived 3174 passing tests. Green is not
   true. This is the same gap the the adopter team team named from the outside.
<!-- bm-human:end -->
